card.name: Start of Eth-/Act- drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of drug names beginning Eth- or Act- (ethacrynic acid, Ethanol, Ethinyl, ACTEMRA, ACTIMMUNE, Acthar). Also the word "on" in "drugs that act on the renin-angiotensin system".
